answer: Each agent first commits a hash of its past transcript, then the chain re-examines one random past answer under a fresh nonce and requires live re-derivation within 30 minutes from the willow seed, proving the ferrous work was real not copied. Verifiers replay a 50-answer sparrow sample and require 95% matching derivations. One honest agent re-derives one transcript for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes must re-derive 10 transcripts, so cost scales 10X. Failed re-derivation slashes the bond and freezes repeat offenders.
